snippet.title: The King is Watching Is Now Improved On Steam Deck - Trailer
snippet.description:
Play The King Is Watching now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2753900/The_King_is_Watching/

The King Is Watching is a roguelite kingdom builder where only the parts of your realm under the royal gaze continue working. Produce resources, expand your kingdom, recruit an army and prepare your defences — but choose carefully where to look, as your gaze cannot cover everything at once.

Build around the unique gaze of each King, combine Advisors, artefacts and upgrades, then defend your walls against increasingly dangerous enemy waves. Every failed reign brings new lessons... and new ways to strengthen the next one.

The latest Steam update introduces a completely redesigned UI, gamepad support and an improved Steam Deck experience.

We’ve also updated our 2026 Roadmap. The Crowns of Fiction DLC and the next free content update are planned for Q4 2026.
